test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All woods are chairs.

All chairs are benches.

All plastics are woods.

**Conclusions:**

I. All woods are benches.

II. All plastics are chairs.

III. No bench is a plastic.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a6e2d1f2b4f5783105a78de56c3429737a86e61b5fca6b43323824edb443134.png] 

I. All woods are benches → True → (As all woods are chairs and all chairs are benches, So all woods are benches is definite follow)
II. All plastics are chairs → True → (As all woods are chairs and all plastics are woods, So all plastics are chairs is definite follow)
III. No bench is a plastic → False → (As all chairs are benches and all plastics are woods, So no bench is a plastic is not followed)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I and II follow".**
